plan.html: • After the line let t = s; runs, where a String was bound to s, what is the state of s?

criteria.description: Selects the option stating that the value moved to t and s is no longer usable.

rubric.full: Ownership transfers to t, so s is no longer valid.
rubric.partial: Zero for the copy option, which treats String as a duplicated value.

plan.html: • Consider let a = String::from("hi"); followed by let b = a; and then println!("{a}");. Explain why the last line fails to compile.

criteria.description: Names the move of the value from a into b.
States that a no longer owns the value, so it cannot be used afterward.

rubric.expected: Ownership of the String moved from a to b when let b = a ran, so a is no longer valid and cannot be used on the last line.
rubric.full: Names the move from a to b and states that a no longer owns the value.
rubric.partial: Gives one of the two required ideas, such as that a was moved, without linking it to the later use.
